lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Staggered horizontal rows of circular high-luminance clusters on the mid-anterior lateral surface, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular spots to form a faint rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges running parallel along the upper lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of small, elongated teleost fish swimming in close proximity to the ventral-anterior region; digital watermark logo 'Village Dive' present in the upper right quadrant.
